ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 75% high-intensity white/cream pixels to 25% low-intensity dark-grey/black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark pigment concentrated along the entire trailing edge boundary and tips. High-frequency dark focal spots (mottling) scattered across the ventral surface. Large, contiguous yellowish-tan geometric regions situated in the mid-lateral sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an approximate internal vertex angle of 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge; multiple distinct peaks and valleys ranging from 3-10 pixels in amplitude, particularly prominent on the distal half of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, slightly posteriorly-curved points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular high-contrast dark pixel clusters (diameter 5-15 pixels) concentrated around the median notch and distal trailing edges.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Focal dark scarring and potential parasitic lesions concentrated at the base of the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-brown biological staining (diatom film) distributed bilaterally in the central lobe regions.
